text:
maya: kicking off a quick reranker throughput sweep across eu/us/apac — sizing notes for Dedicated pools. focus: dims 256/512/768, batch 8/32/128, cpu vs gpu, kernel choices.
jun: SGTM. what hardware are we testing on?
maya: A100-40GB (us-west), A10G (eu-west), and a 64-core c6i-like instance for cpu fallback in apac.
olivia: any quant configs? int8 fp16?
maya: baseline fp16, plus q4_0 and q4_1 for the 768 model. expecting perf delta ~1.3-1.8x on GPU, maybe 4-5x on CPU for int8.
simon: sharing initial micro numbers from the run:
perf-bot: attach: https://artifacts.redwood/internal/sweeps/1812500000/summary.html
perf-bot: snippet:
```
A100 fp16 dims=768 batch=32: 9.8k qps, p95=18ms
A10G fp16 dims=768 batch=32: 6.2k qps, p95=28ms
CPU 64-core q8 dims=768 batch=8: 1.1k qps, p95=120ms
A100 q4_1 dims=768 batch=32: 12.1k qps, p95=20ms
```
jun: interesting that q4_1 increased throughput but p95 got worse vs fp16 on A100 — kernel/attn tradeoff?
pradeep: probably kernel selection for matmul+quant dequant pairs. need to compare perf counters.
olivia: can we run same sweep with continuous batching enabled? that changed tail a lot last quarter.
maya: yes added continuous batching flag for next run. expected to drop p95 by 10-25% for small batches.
simon: regional notes — eu-west A10G had higher p95 due to multi-tenant noisy neighbors on test cluster. re-run on isolated node planned.
jun: for capacity calc — which qps target? product wants 5k sustained per region with p95 < 50ms.
maya: target per-region steady qps: 5k. safety buffer 1.5x for spikes => 7.5k. for dims=768 and fp16 on A100 that maps to ~1 pod per 12k qps so 1 pod should be fine but need cross-check for canary/autoscale headroom.
pradeep: recommendation: use A100 fp16 for primary, fall back to A10G q4_1 when cost-sensitive. CPU only for emergencies — it's no-go for latency-sensitive SLAs.
olivia: action items:
- re-run A10G on isolated node (simon)
- run continuous batching sweep (maya)
- collect kernel perf counters and ATTENTION kernel breakdown (pradeep)
- update capacity calc doc with 1.5x buffer and quantized profiles (jun)
maya: noted. will drop run links here when done. :thumbsup:
jun: also add test for dims=256 with batch=128 — product sometimes uses smaller vectors and that could change pod math.
maya: adding dims=256/512/768 to the sweep matrix.
perf-bot: run queued (id: sweep-1812500000-2). ETA ~45m.
pradeep: quick FYI — if we enable prefix KV caching for rerank it's going to reduce token work but may increase memory pressure; factor into pod sizing.
maya: good call. include KV cache on one of the test arms.
olivia: thanks folks — will sync after the second sweep, then draft Dedicated capacity proposal for EU/US/APAC.
maya: tagging @eng-platform for rollout notes once we have final numbers.
